title: Switching Hamiltonian Monte Carlo for sampling from mixture distributions
summary: We introduce a switching Hamiltonian Monte Carlo method for sampling from finite mixture Boltzmann-Gibbs distributions. We propose symmetric numerical integrators to approximate switching Hamiltonian dynamics interlaced with Poisson jumps, where the regime-switching chain is simulated using the uniformization technique or the stochastic simulation algorithm. We prove geometric ergodicity of the resulting Markov chain.
